findings.title: Prism tag tokens collide with HeroUI Tag styles
findings.evidence: With wrapping enabled, the JSX SearchInput line splits into separate columns. DOM inspection confirms .token.tag computes to inline-flex because HeroUI defines a global .tag class with flex layout, spacing, padding and select-none.
findings.recommendation: Namespace Prism token-type classes and update syntax selectors, or otherwise isolate syntax tokens from component CSS. Verify JSX and HTML wrapping and text selection. Diff already shared the collision before this change; new Markdown highlighting expands the affected surface.

findings.title: New callbacks invalidate historical message memoization
findings.evidence: toolOpen and onToggleTool are recreated each Conversation render and passed to every memoized MessageView. Message updates therefore invalidate all historical MessageView prop comparisons.
findings.recommendation: Use a stable toggle callback and pass stable per-message or per-tool state instead of a changing lookup callback. The render invalidation follows from code inspection; runtime streaming performance was not profiled.

findings.title: Existing Nord muted text lacks contrast
findings.evidence: Current Nord dark token #616e88 on #2e3440 has contrast 2.43:1. User attachment also shows very faint tool labels. Attachment correspondence to this revision is unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Improve the theme token or introduce a readable secondary text token; keep filenames more prominent than operation verbs. This is an existing theme issue, not a newly introduced token change.

findings.title: Short command draft produces a scrollbar
findings.evidence: Current draft-field clientHeight=51 and scrollHeight=52, editor clientHeight=45 and scrollHeight=46; visible scrollbar despite short content.
findings.recommendation: Check chip baseline/top offset and line-box overflow so short drafts do not scroll. Preserve scrolling for actual long drafts.
